lessons.title: 🎨 Colors and Numbers (1-10)
points: Numbers: One (1), Two (2), Three (3), Four (4), Five (5), Six (6), Seven (7), Eight (8), Nine (9), Ten (10).
Colors: Red (Kırmızı), Blue (Mavi), Yellow (Sarı), Green (Yeşil), Orange (Turuncu), Black (Siyah), White (Beyaz).
lessons.examTip: 💡 Exam Tip: 'Blue' mavi, 'Yellow' sarı, 'Green' yeşil demektir!
